title: The month onion prices fell across India
summary: In March 2018, the median onion market moved -37.9% in a month, 2.0 standard deviations from the usual for that month.
why_selected: Chosen automatically: the 2.0σ seasonal move is among the largest on record for onion, across 636 reporting markets.

evidence.observations: monthly medians of daily modal prices; markets need ≥5 reports in both months
caveats: Many market points are district centres, not mandi gates.
Modal prices are reported aggregates, not transaction offers.

scenes.headline: March 2018
scenes.caption: Onion prices across 636 markets that reported in both February 2018 and March 2018.

scenes.headline: Median move -37.9%
scenes.caption: The typical market's onion price fell 37.9% in one month. 99% of markets moved the same way.

scenes.headline: 2.0× the usual swing
scenes.caption: Compared with the same month in every earlier year on record, this move was 2.0 standard deviations from normal.

scenes.headline: Gujarat
scenes.caption: Neighbouring markets moved together: the 18 reporting markets in Gujarat had a median change of -48.2%.

scenes.headline: Surat
scenes.caption: Surat (Gujarat), one of the busiest markets among the biggest movers: monthly median ₹1,875 → ₹925 per quintal (-50.7%).

scenes.headline: What this does and doesn't show
scenes.caption: These are reported wholesale modal prices, not causes. Weather, arrivals or policy may explain the move, but this story shows only what markets reported.

conclusion: These are reported wholesale modal prices, not causes. Weather, arrivals or policy may explain the move, but this story shows only what markets reported.
